nodes.description: Global swap counter and total number of swaps created; incremented after external calls in open flows.
Mapping of swap id to Swap struct holding open/close values, traders, contract addresses, type and status.
ERC20 token used to pay swap fees; set at initialization and by owner.
Payable wallet receiving 80% of collected fees; receives ETH via low-level call.
Wallet receiving 10% developer fee portion.
ETH fee percentage (in tenths of a percent) configurable by owner.
Maximum allowed fee slippage percentage for underpaid swap fees.
Uniswap fee percentage subtracted from price estimates.
External price estimator contract used for fee computation; set by owner.
Mapping of tokens exempt from fees, managed by owner.
External initializer setting swap token, fee wallets and price estimator; protected by onlyContract but not by an owner check.
Payable external entry point that validates inputs then dispatches to the three open implementations.
Opens an ETH->ERC20 swap; collects fees via low-level call or token transfers before writing swap storage.
Opens an ERC20->ETH swap; collects fees then pulls ERC20 from the opener.
Opens an ERC20->ERC20 swap; collects fees then pulls opening tokens from the caller.
Payable external entry point that checks the caller is the closeTrader and dispatches close logic.
Closes an ETH->ERC20 swap, distributing fees and transferring tokens then ETH to the ERC20 trader.
Closes an ERC20->ETH swap, distributing fees, returning tokens and pushing ETH to the open trader via low-level call.
Closes an ERC20->ERC20 swap, distributing fees and moving both token legs.
External cancellation entry point restricted to the original open trader.
Cancels an ETH->ERC20 swap and refunds ETH via transfer.
Cancels an ERC20 swap and refunds the opening tokens.
Splits fee into dev/burn/remainder and pushes tokens with safeTransferFrom and burnFrom from msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for the fee wallet address.
Owner-only setter for the developer wallet address.
Owner-only setter for the swap token address.
Owner-only function adding a token to the free token list.
Owner-only function removing a token from the free token list.
View helper computing the ETH fee from an amount using _ethFeePercentage.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, fee debits and swap authorization.
Low-level ETH transfer to _feesWallet forwarding all gas, allowing reentrancy into the calling function.
ETH transfer to the stored openTrader address during close/cancel operations.
Low-level ETH call to the stored openTrader during _closeERC20ToEther, forwarding all gas.
External token transfer pulling fee tokens from msg.sender to fee/dev wallets.
External ERC20 calls moving user tokens in and out of the contract during open/close/cancel.
External burn call debiting the burn fee from msg.sender.
User supplied fee amount compared against the minimum required fee.
Amount the opener commits to the swap.
Amount the counterparty must commit when closing.
Swap identifier indexing _swaps used by close and cancel.
Counterparty address authorized to close the swap.
Token address used for fee payments, validated as a contract.
Fee receiving wallet set at initialization.
Developer wallet set at initialization.
Price estimator contract address set at initialization.
New fee wallet address supplied by the owner.
Token address toggled in the free token list.
Swap struct loaded into memory/storage while processing close and cancel.
Minimum fee computed in swap tokens when the fee is paid in swap token.
Minimum fee computed in ETH when the fee is paid in ETH.
Boolean result of low-level ETH calls checked with require.

edges.reason: initialize is externally callable and has no owner/initialized caller restriction, so any msg.sender can configure or front-run the upgradeable contract.
msg.sender is stored as openTrader and used to pull opening tokens/fees.
close authorization depends on msg.sender equalling swap.closeTrader, a caller-controlled identity check.
cancel authorization depends on msg.sender equalling swap.openTrader.
msg.sender is the account debited by safeTransferFrom and burnFrom in fee distribution.
onlyOwner gates setFeeWallet on msg.sender equalling _owner.
onlyOwner gates setDevWallet on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates setSwapToken on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates addTokenToFreeList on msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates removeTokenFromFreeList on msg.sender.
open dispatches to _openEtherToERC20 when the open contract is the ETH sentinel.
open dispatches to _openERC20ToEther when the close contract is the ETH sentinel.
open dispatches to _openERC20ToERC20 for token-to-token swaps.
close dispatches to _closeEtherToERC20 for ETH_TO_ERC20 swaps.
close dispatches to _closeERC20ToEther for ERC20_TO_ETH swaps.
close dispatches to _closeERC20ToERC20 for ERC20_TO_ERC20 swaps.
cancel dispatches to _cancelEtherToERC20 for ETH_TO_ERC20 swaps.
cancel dispatches to _cancelERC20 for token swaps.

_openERC20ToEther calls _distributeFees with the computed minimum fee.
_openERC20ToERC20 calls _distributeFees with the computed minimum fee.

_closeERC20ToEther distributes fees before transferring value.
_closeERC20ToERC20 distributes fees before moving tokens.
Low-level ETH call to _feesWallet executes after which _swapId and _swaps are updated, allowing reentrant state manipulation.

ETH fee is pushed to _feesWallet via call.value before swap state is written.

ETH fee is pushed to _feesWallet via call.value during close.
ETH fee is pushed to _feesWallet via call.value during close.

_distributeFees performs external safeTransferFrom pulls on _swapToken.
_distributeFees invokes burnFrom on the swap token to burn the burn-share of the fee.
_closeEtherToERC20 pulls the close leg with transferFrom on the user supplied token.
_closeERC20ToERC20 pulls closing tokens and pushes opening tokens via external ERC20 calls.
_cancelERC20 returns opening tokens via an external ERC20 transfer.

_closeERC20ToERC20 mutates swap.status in the _swaps mapping.

_openERC20ToEther increments _swapId with SafeMath add.
_openERC20ToERC20 increments _swapId with SafeMath add.

safeTransferFrom moves _swapToken balances held by the fee payer.
burnFrom burns _swapToken from the fee payer.

normalization_plan.reason: The fee parameter only flows into the open entry point and its private helpers.
openValue is validated and forwarded by open.
closeValue is validated and forwarded by open.
The swap id parameter is only used to index _swaps inside close.
closeTrader is stored by open as the authorized closing party.
Only consumed by the initialize initializer.
Only consumed by the initialize initializer.
Only consumed by the initialize initializer.
Only consumed by the initialize initializer.
The wallet parameter belongs solely to the setFeeWallet setter.
The token parameter belongs solely to the free-list admin function.
The Swap memory/storage struct is only a local view of _swaps during close processing.
The computed minimum swap fee is passed directly into fee distribution.
The computed minimum ETH fee is passed directly into fee payment.
The success boolean is only the return value check of the low-level fee call.
